positions.title: Fire Department staff (Fire Chief, Deputy Chief, Lieutenants, Firefighters)
positions.notes: Department-level figure: 20 budgeted FTE with $1,271,314.00 in proposed FY2027 salaries/wages (average $63,566 per FTE; titles and individual pay not itemized). The Fire account detail shows Regular Salaries $1,279,915 for '20 FTEs' (FY2026 amended $1,214,047), shift overtime $159,355, special pay/annual bonus $11,740, and a $3,120 grant-funded firefighter supplemental compensation for 3 members. Cell allowances go to the Fire Chief, Deputy Chief and Lieutenants. The account detail and the personnel summary ($1,271,314) differ by $8,601, which equals the 'Trng Amt' column.
